files.description: Full HTML of the registered MACRA/MIPS page containing the ONC certification section and the single-paragraph EHI Export Functionality description. This is the primary mandatory disclosures page.
Full-page screenshot of the registered MACRA/MIPS page showing all sections including certification info, real world test plans, API links, and EHI Export Functionality section.
Focused screenshot of the ONC Health IT Certification heading on the MACRA/MIPS page.
Focused screenshot of the EHI Export Functionality heading — the single paragraph constituting the entire EHI export documentation on the registered page.

FHIR API User Guide (May 2025). Documents SmileCDR-powered FHIR R4 API for USCDI v1 data. Covers (g)(10) standardized API access, not (b)(10) EHI export. Lists US Core resource types, OAuth authentication, registration process. 33+ pages.
General Clinical API Documentation (2023). Older patient-facing API providing JSON access to clinical data via API key authentication through the patient portal. Not a (b)(10) mechanism.

Costs and Guidance document (December 2022). Describes certified module costs and guidance. Still references 'Kareo EHR' and (b)(6) data portability, not (b)(10) EHI export. Outdated relative to December 2024 certification.

2024 Real World Test Results. Contains RWT Measure #4 documenting actual (b)(10) EHI export usage: 3,931 exports across 790 practices over 3 months. Describes exports as including C-CDAs and other patient documents. Most substantive EHI export evidence found.

2025 Real World Test Plan. RWT Measure #4 explicitly tests 315(b)(10) EHI exports, describing the measure as tracking patient-requested EHI exports in computable format. Mentions database reports to count exports.
2024 Real World Test Plan. RWT Measure #4 originally targeted 315(b)(6) Patient Batch Export of C-CDAs (later retroactively substituted for (b)(10) in the results).
2022 Real World Test Plan. Pre-dates (b)(10) certification.
2022 Real World Test Results. Pre-dates (b)(10) certification.
2023 Real World Test Plan. Pre-dates (b)(10) certification.
2023 Real World Test Results. Pre-dates (b)(10) certification.

Tebra Help Center article describing how to export patient clinical data as C-CDA Summary of Care files. Covers one-time and recurring exports, date range filtering, provider selection, and zip download. No field-level detail.
Full-page screenshot of the Export Patient Clinical Data help center article showing the export interface and instructions.
21st Century Cures Act FAQ page from help center. Describes EHI scope, patient portal access to USCDI data, ShareFile service for other EHI categories, and links to the Cures Act Request Form.
Full-page screenshot of the 21st Century Cures Act FAQ help center article.

Cures Act Request Form page HTML. Contains a OneTrust-powered privacy portal iframe where patients can request EHI export across 19 data categories. The form itself is loaded dynamically from privacyportal.onetrust.com.

Full-page screenshot of the Cures Act Request Form showing the 19 selectable EHI data categories (Allergies, Clinical Notes, Medications, Demographics, Problems, etc.) and patient identification fields.
